title: AA-2025-1674-PM-1A
text:
AA-2025-1674-PM-1A  Council District 1 – Hernandez
  CEQA: ENV-2025-1675-CE  Last Day to Act: 10-28-26
  Plan Area: Northeast Los Angeles

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  2236 West Avenue 33; 2249 North Cazador Drive

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  Subdivision of one lot into two separate parcels in the R2-1-HCR Zone located at 2336 West Avenue 33
  and 2249 North Cazador Drive in the Northeast Los Angeles Community Plan area. The subdivision will
  result in two buildable parcels. Parcel A will comprise of 9,345 square feet of lot area and will retain an
  existing one-story single-family dwelling, detached garage, one-story accessory structure and deck. Parcel
  B will consist of 9,473 square-feet and will retain a single-family dwelling with an attached garage that was
  under construction at the time the case was filed. No new construction is proposed as part of the
  subdivision.

  APPEAL:
  An appeal of the June 9, 2026 Deputy Advisory Agency’s determination, which:
  1. Determined, based on the whole of the administrative record that the Project is exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15315, Class 15
  (Minor Land Divisions), and there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that an exception based
  on location, cumulative impacts, significant effects or unusual circumstances, scenic highways, or
  hazardous waste sites, or historical resources to a categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA
  Guidelines Section 15300.2 applies; and
  2. Approved with Conditions, pursuant to Los Angeles Municipal Code Chapter 1 Sections 17.51 and
  17.53 and Chapter 1A Section 13B.7.5, a Preliminary Parcel Map No. AA-2025-1674-PM, located at
  2236 West Avenue 33 – 2249 North Cazador Drive, for the subdivision of one lot into two separate
  parcels in the R2-1-HCR Zone, as shown on map Stamp-dated June 30, 2025; and
  3. Adopted the Conditions of Approval and Findings.

  Applicant/
  Appellant:  Nathan D. Showalter
  Representative: Magdalene and Kevin Lai, CaliLand Engineering, Inc.

  Staff:  Pablo Estrada, City Planning Associate
